title: Thumbs UP Season 4 Trailer
summary: A 55-second official-channel travel trailer made of widely separated caption fragments: career questions about archaeology/helping poor people and CJ; a dead/burned/“evil” forest; an unresolved “jumper”; a straight/ride line followed by travelers saying a driver stopped before they began hitchhiking; an unresolved found-money fragment; a question asking whether Mormons love chicken and watermelon; and a final chair line. Every fragment remains uncensored, but none is joined into a continuous event or speaker. “Jumper” may refer to a person, animal or object and stays audiovisual-required with self-harm sensitivity. The stranger ride is not safety guidance, “money from heaven” proves no ownership, and the Mormon/food question is preserved as stereotype bait without an available answer or inferred endorsement. CJ is not identified/profiled. Zero named turns ship.
